description: Defines the QuicConnectivityMonitor class responsible for monitoring QUIC connection path degradation and recovery events on the default network interface, including handling network updates, IP address changes, and session events.

classes.name: QuicConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Monitors path degradation and recovery events for QUIC sessions on the default network, manages session states, and records connectivity statistics.

methods.name: QuicConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with the default network handle.

methods.name: RecordConnectivityStatsToHistograms
methods.description: Records connectivity-related statistics to histograms based on platform notifications and affected network.

methods.name: GetNumDegradingSessions
methods.description: Returns the count of sessions currently degrading on the default network.

methods.name: GetCountForWriteErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the number of reports received for a specific write error code on the default network.

methods.name: SetInitialDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Sets up the initial default network when tracking is lost upon creation.

methods.name: OnDefaultNetworkUpdated
methods.description: Updates the monitor when the default network interface changes.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles IP address changes when handles::NetworkHandle is not supported.

methods.name: OnSessionGoingAwayOnIPAddressChange
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a session goes away due to IP address change.

methods.name: OnSessionPathDegrading
methods.description: Callback for when a session's path is detected as degrading.

methods.name: OnSessionResumedPostPathDegrading
methods.description: Callback for when a session resumes after path degradation.

methods.name: OnSessionEncounteringWriteError
methods.description: Handles write error events for sessions.

methods.name: OnSessionClosedAfterHandshake
methods.description: Handles cleanup after a session closes post-handshake.

methods.name: OnSessionRegistered
methods.description: Registers a new session with the monitor.
